exact_match.reason: Source file matches record.after byte-for-byte; step (i) exact match path restores before bytes

prettier_default.reason: Benign code formatting preserved under token-level undo

prettier_alt.reason: Alternative prettier options (useTabs, singleQuote, printWidth 40) formatting preserved

tailwind_reorder.reason: Class reordering via tailwind plugin preserved under token multiset restoration

edit_unrelated_line.reason: Unrelated line modification elsewhere in component preserved

rename_variable.reason: Variable renaming elsewhere in file preserved

insert_import.reason: Import statements added at top of file preserved

duplicate_unrelated_element.reason: Duplicating another element in component preserved

stacked_second_edit_on_a_DIFFERENT_eleme.reason: Independent edits on different elements in same file are undoable via identity-based dependency checking

interleaved_multi_element_undo.reason: N edits (2..5) on distinct elements with random benign action between consecutive edits, then undo in random order accepted with final bytes equal to file after benign actions

delete_target.reason: Target element was deleted; cannot locate element safely

wrap_target_in_conditional.reason: Target element wrapped in conditional; safety rule prohibits editing inside conditions

stacked_second_edit_on_SAME_element.reason: Newer edit on the same element depends on this edit; must undo newer edit first

stacked_same_element_reflow.reason: Same element edited twice with Prettier reflow between; newer edit depends on older edit, must refuse

user_changed_same_token.reason: User modified the added/removed tokens; cannot safely resolve token conflict

external_overwrite.reason: File was overwritten externally with incompatible content

rename_tag.reason: Tag name of target element changed

duplicate_target.reason: Target element duplicated, causing sibling ambiguity without unique id

element_moved_into_loop.reason: Target element moved into repeating list or map loop; safety rule prohibits loop edits

wrap_target_in_div.reason: Target element wrapped in an extra container div altering component hierarchy

reorder_children_containing_target.reason: Structural reordering of children containing target element blocks undo
